entries.headline: MetroCity Bankshares reports $24.3 million third-quarter net income
entries.dek: Diluted earnings per share rose to $0.84 for the quarter, with nine-month net income reaching $68.7 million, both ahead of the prior year.
entries.caption: Metro City Bank's holding company reported higher third-quarter profit, deposits and loan balances as of September 30, 2026.

sources.title: METROCITY BANKSHARES, INC. REPORTS EARNINGS FOR THIRD QUARTER 2026

unverified_claims: Quarterly and nine-month financial results are as reported by the company in its earnings release and have not yet been reflected in a Form 10-Q filing.
brief: MetroCity Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: MCBS), the holding company for Metro City Bank, reported net income of $24.3 million, or $0.84 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026. That compares with $22.1 million, or $0.76 per diluted share, in the second quarter, and $17.3 million, or $0.67 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net income was $68.7 million, or $2.37 per diluted share, against $50.4 million, or $1.96 per diluted share, for the same period in 2025. The company reported return on average assets of 2.12%, return on average equity of 16.97% and a net interest margin of 4.07% for the quarter.

At quarter-end, total assets stood at $4.60 billion, gross loans held for investment at $3.98 billion and total deposits at $3.56 billion, of which 23.3% was noninterest-bearing. Dividends per share for the nine months reached $0.87, up from $0.71 a year earlier. The release's cautionary language notes results could differ with economic and rate conditions.
body: MetroCity Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: MCBS), the Atlanta-based holding company for Metro City Bank, reported net income of $24.3 million, or $0.84 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026 ended September 30, 2026, according to its earnings release dated October 23, 2026.

The third-quarter result compares with net income of $22.1 million, or $0.76 per diluted share, in the second quarter of 2026, and with $17.3 million, or $0.67 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025 — increases of 9.8% and 40.7%, respectively, as stated in the release.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the company reported net income of $68.7 million, or $2.37 per diluted share, compared with $50.4 million, or $1.96 per diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, an increase of 36.4%.
For the third quarter, MetroCity reported return on average assets of 2.12%, return on average equity of 16.97% and a net interest margin of 4.07%, according to the release.

At September 30, 2026, the company reported total assets of $4.60 billion, gross loans held for investment of $3.98 billion and total deposits of $3.56 billion. Noninterest-bearing deposits were $828.3 million, representing 23.3% of total deposits, and uninsured deposits represented 34.7% of total deposits.

Dividends paid per share for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 totaled $0.87, compared with $0.71 for the same period in 2025. The release names Farid Tan as President and Interim Chief Financial Officer; no other executive is quoted.

The release includes cautionary language stating that actual results could differ from any forward-looking statements due to factors including economic and market conditions, changes in interest rates, competitive pressures in the banking industry, and regulatory developments. It provides no additional guidance beyond the figures reported for the quarter and nine-month period.

entries.headline: Permian Basin Royalty Trust sets date for unitholder vote
entries.dek: Record date is October 13 and the special meeting is set for November 23, 2026, to vote on a proposed business combination and incentive plan.
entries.caption: Argent Trust Company set a record date and meeting date for Permian Basin Royalty Trust unitholders to vote on SoftVest-requested proposals.

sources.title: PERMIAN BASIN ROYALTY TRUST ANNOUNCES RECORD DATE AND MEETING DATE FOR SPECIAL MEETING TO CONSIDER SOFTVEST PROPOSALS

unverified_claims: SoftVest Advisors, LLC's stated ownership, together with other unitholders, of more than 15% of outstanding trust units is as asserted in the request to the trustee, per the release.
brief: Argent Trust Company, as trustee of Permian Basin Royalty Trust (NYSE: PBT), announced a record date of October 13, 2026 and a special meeting of unitholders for November 23, 2026. The meeting was requested by SoftVest Advisors, LLC together with other unitholders the trust says collectively hold more than 15% of outstanding units.

Unitholders will vote on three proposals: an amendment to the Trust Indenture to effect a Business Combination under a Combination Agreement; the terms of the PBT Land and Minerals, Inc. Omnibus Incentive Plan; and authority to adjourn the meeting if needed to solicit additional proxies. The trustee said it is not recommending how unitholders should vote.

The release does not describe the terms of the Business Combination or the incentive plan; it directs unitholders to the trust's Form S-4 and Form S-1 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission. A formal notice of the meeting was to be mailed to unitholders beginning October 23, 2026.
body: Argent Trust Company, as trustee ('Trustee') of Permian Basin Royalty Trust (NYSE: PBT), announced on October 23, 2026 that it has set a record date of October 13, 2026 and a special meeting date of November 23, 2026 for unitholders to vote on proposals tied to a previously disclosed Business Combination.
The special meeting was called at the request of SoftVest Advisors, LLC, together with other holders of trust units who, the release states, collectively own more than 15% of outstanding units.
The first proposal asks unitholders to approve and adopt the terms of an amendment to the Trust Indenture to effect the Business Combination pursuant to a Combination Agreement.
The second proposal asks unitholders to approve and adopt the terms of the PBT Land and Minerals, Inc. Omnibus Incentive Plan. The release does not describe what the plan covers beyond its name.
The third proposal would authorize an adjournment of the special meeting, if necessary or appropriate, to permit the solicitation of additional proxies.

The trustee states that it is not making any recommendation to unitholders as to how to vote on the proposals. It said additional details regarding the special meeting would be set forth in the trustee's notice, to be mailed to unitholders beginning October 23, 2026.

For the substance of the Business Combination and the incentive plan, the release directs unitholders to the trust's Form S-4 and Form S-1 registration statements filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, rather than describing their terms itself.

entries.headline: Manufacturing sales edged up 0.1 percent in September
entries.dek: Statistics Canada's advance estimate points to gains led by petroleum and coal products and aerospace, with final figures due November 13.
entries.caption: Statistics Canada's advance estimate shows manufacturing sales edging up 0.1 percent in September, with final figures due in November.

sources.title: Monthly Survey of Manufacturing: Advance indicator, September 2026

brief: Statistics Canada's advance indicator estimates that total manufacturing sales edged up 0.1% in September 2026. The largest increases were in the petroleum and coal product subsector and the aerospace product and parts industry group; the agency gives no specific percentage for either.

The advance estimate is based on a weighted response rate of 71.3%, compared with an average final response rate of 92.4% over the preceding 12 months, so it carries more revision risk than a final figure.

Statistics Canada's official manufacturing sales figures for September are scheduled for release on November 13, 2026. The advance release gives no breakdown of other subsectors and no commentary beyond the aggregate figure and the two named industry groups.
body: Statistics Canada released an advance indicator on October 23, 2026 estimating that total manufacturing sales edged up 0.1% in September 2026. The agency said the largest increases were in the petroleum and coal product subsector and the aerospace product and parts industry group.
The release gives no specific percentage change for either of those two groups, and no figures for any other subsector.

Statistics Canada said the advance estimate is based on a weighted response rate of 71.3%, compared with an average final response rate of 92.4% over the preceding 12 months — a lower response rate that the agency says carries more risk of revision than a final estimate.

The agency's official manufacturing sales figures for September 2026 are scheduled for release on November 13, 2026. The disclosure in this advance release is limited to the single aggregate figure, the two named industry groups, and the response-rate caveat; no further detail or commentary is given.
